tabs.body_html:
Overview

This is placeholder content for the State of Tariffs interactive. The structure, navigation, and chart-engine wiring are in place; the figures and text below are samples to be replaced with real content.

Use the tabs above to move between sections. Within each tab, the list on the left selects which figure to view; toggles and selectors (where present) switch between views of the same data.

What this tool will cover

  • Tariff Levels — the overall U.S. tariff rate over time, rates by trading partner, and a detailed rate table.
  • Revenue & Prices — estimated tariff revenue and the pass-through of tariffs to consumer prices.

All numbers currently shown are illustrative placeholders, not Budget Lab estimates.

figures.body_html: The average tariff rate is the total duties collected divided by the value of goods imports. The Weighting toggle switches between fixed import weights (held at a base-period mix) and dynamic weights (the current import mix). This is placeholder text describing the figure.

figures.body_html: Average U.S. tariff rate applied to imports from a selected trading partner. Use the Trading partner selector to switch the series shown. This is placeholder text describing the figure.

Statutory and effective tariff rates and the implied import-price passthrough under three scenarios. The row labels use inline math (rendered by the chart engine) to demonstrate the v1.1.1 table feature. All values are illustrative placeholders.
